title: Nightly job to purge abandoned carts
description: Abandoned carts pile up forever (2.1M rows). This adds a nightly job that deletes carts in status `abandoned` not touched for 30 days, and registers it in the job list.
notes: head/.eslintrc.json is an unchanged repo file (not in pr.patch). FixturePrSource.getRepoFile serves it so the style agent receives it as a lint config. The new job violates three of its rules: no-restricted-imports (moment), import/no-default-export, no-console.
